relationship_to_v1: additive; the v1 freeze and scores are unchanged

components.memory_agent: distills answered hints and orchestrates paired validation through a pluggable executor
components.memory_service: owns persistence, provenance, retrieval, evidence registration, and promotion gate
components.transport: in-process interface or authenticated HTTP; remote clients require HTTPS
components.robocasa_paired_executor: trusted development callbacks or sandboxed generated policies with independent safety monitoring and deadline/cancellation preflight

persistence.per_run_evidence: existing task-seed-time trace/result/bundle directories remain separate
persistence.manifest: MEMORY.json binds identity, status, applicability, core record digest, and SHA-256 of generated files
persistence.recovery: regenerate from SQLite through Memory Service export; never import edited files as authoritative state

source_chain: response with human, curated-human-packet, or advisor-proxy identity
versioned structured artifact with SHA-256 and exact task/perception applicability
candidate_semantics: an answered hint is an untrusted proposed intervention; effectiveness is established only by paired validation before promotion
raw_evidence: candidate provenance retains raw trace ID, evidence URI/SHA-256, received guidance and response-content SHA-256; source response lineage/content and original artifact bytes are checked before promotion and trusted retrieval

requires: trusted status at catalog and use time
matching concrete camera names and task prompt
explicit policy retrieval event with memory version and Service-issued attempt-bound grant
normal_retrieval.candidate_use: only in an explicitly labelled development validation run
normal_retrieval.cross_mode_reuse: forbidden without a separate transfer validation

promotion_gate.policy_version: one fixed validation code digest across every pair/case; source code digest is recorded separately and may differ after a repair
promotion_gate.variation_plan: five or more predefined development cases; scene/object IDs are simulator-attested, camera_names are perception-attested, task_prompt varies within the same task_id, and all four axes vary
promotion_gate.coverage: every planned case must be paired before promotion; a counterexample removes its full variation tuple from retrieval scope; an empty validated scope blocks promotion
promotion_gate.treatment: raw trace metadata and explicit retrieval event must attest exactly the candidate memory use
promotion_gate.outcome: native evaluator and raw trace must agree for validation pairs; trusted use outcome and memory version must agree with the retrieval trace; timeout, cancellation, and evaluator-unavailable uses are logged without inventing an authoritative native verdict and cannot count as completed promotion pairs
promotion_gate.safety: independent monitor artifact required for each run; no treatment safety regression in any pair, regardless of aggregate unsafe-attempt totals
promotion_gate.success: positive paired success gain or positive assistance credits saved on both-success pairs, with no success regression; >=3 treatment successes and >=0.75 treatment success fraction
promotion_gate.heldout: forbidden during memory development and promotion

metrics: future assistance credits saved, separated into both-success and both-failed pairs
source human attention seconds and seconds per success gain when human-sourced

operator_lifecycle.authorization: separate operator key in addition to Memory Service API key
operator_lifecycle.audit: actor and reason recorded; non-trusted memories are not retrieved

not_implemented_here: formal success-attention frontier across all assistance budgets
demo-video corpus and budgeted demo retrieval
independent collision/contact telemetry for simulator GT runners
live generated-policy paired validation and trusted-memory reuse evidence
live deployment and acceptance of maniskill_sim variation attestation
live Robosuite successful-policy paired validation and promotion evidence
